purpose: Teach: アットホーム/ともなっ/見なし/三四郎/インテリジェント/平年/山川/加護

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お店のアットホームな雰囲気をお褒め下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, a customer told me the shop has such a warm, welcoming atmosphere.
lines.style: Soft, almost tentative. Sharing something small she noticed about a moment. Gentle cadence, like she's thinking aloud rather than reporting.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、「年齢をともなって成長されてる」って語って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: They said I'm growing as I get older—that's what they told me, Mei.
lines.style: Surprised by the compliment but trying not to show it too much. Quiet wonder underneath. A slight catch in the voice, like she's still turning it over.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、当店を「都内有数の名店と見なしてる」って仰ってたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: One of our regulars actually called this place one of the best cafés in Tokyo.
lines.style: Modest pleasure in the delivery. Not boasting—more like she can't quite believe it herself. Soft on the ending, almost questioning.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ご自身を「現代の三四郎」って笑ってらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: They joked that they're like Sanshiro in modern times—said it laughing at themselves.
lines.style: A small, knowing smile in the voice. Amused at the customer's self-aware humor. Light, almost conspiratorial—she's sharing the joke with Mei.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、「インテリジェントなお話を楽しんでます」って仰ってたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: They said they really enjoy our thoughtful conversations.
lines.style: Genuine warmth returning. She's settling back into simple observation. Unhurried pacing, soft landing on the compliment.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、「平年並みの売上で安定」って語って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: They mentioned the shop's doing steadily—sales are normal, nothing dramatic.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, practical note. No inflection of worry or pride. Just relaying what was said. Slightly tired undertone—everyday business talk.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お孫様の名前が山川くんだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Oh, and their grandson's name is Yamakawa.
lines.style: Small, casual detail slipped in. Like she's just remembering it. A light touch of warmth—remembering someone's family matters to her.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、「お加護を頂いて健康で居られる」って仰ってたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: They said they're grateful for blessings—that's how they stay healthy.
lines.style: Respectful and genuine. Slower pace here, honoring what was shared. Soft, almost reverent close. Like she's handing Mei something precious.
